summary: Published src/content/blog/beginner/is-palmistry-real.md, an evidence/trust FAQ for skeptical readers distinct from what-palmistry-is.md's history-and-definition overview. Separates historical predictive claims (Cheiro, Benham, Varahamihira) from what the evidence does/doesn't establish (no scientific support for occult predictive meaning; Ray Hyman's account kept as anecdote not experiment) from why the site still treats palmistry as worth studying. Added one reciprocal link from what-palmistry-is.md and updated the canonical docs.
